name: 甘姆星云 · 船底座
orientation: east-left-north-up; row 0 south; columns increase west

continuum.source: SHASSA continuum image (dR equivalent in the 3.2 nm Hα filter), 5×5 median (stars removed); black body 4500 K assumed

stars.encoding: float32-le [X, Y, F550 W/m2/nm, Tcolour K]
stars.model: Black body at Ballesteros (2012) colour temperature from B−V (Gaia BP−RP inverted via DR3 Table 5.9), normalized to Bessell (1998) V=0 flux at 550 nm; observed (reddened) colours.

template.source: Case B Balmer ratios (Storey & Hummer 1995); [O III] 4959/5007 = 1/2.98; low-density [S II] 6716/6731 = 1.4; continuum EW(Hβ)=1370 Å (assumed). Other lines missing.

notes: 80° 场景：Hα 为 SHASSA（V<5 亮星的饱和核与光环按亮度遮掉 1071 个像素并用约 1° 分块平滑背景填补，另有 17600 个恒星残差像素用中值替换）。

银河的未分辨星光来自 SHASSA 连续谱图（Hα 滤镜内连续谱的 dR 当量，滤镜等效宽度取 3.2 nm，5×5 中值去掉恒星），并扣除其中的夜天光底（约 5° 分块的 5% 分位数，中位约 45 R 当量 ≈ V 21.7 mag/″²，夜空由模拟器单独给出）；换算到 550 nm 时假设 4500 K 黑体。扣除后面亮度：中位 V 23.9、90% 分位 V 22.5、99% 分位 V 21.5 mag/″²。比 Gaia G<10.5 暗的恒星都在这一层里。
missing: 南天广域的 [O III] 与 [S II]（没有定标巡天，按 0 处理）
sources: SHASSA (Gaustad et al. 2001, PASP 113, 1326), continuum-subtracted Hα in deci-Rayleigh, ~0.8′; via CDS hips2fits (ov-gso/P/SHASSA)
SHASSA continuum (ov-gso/P/SHASSA/CONT) as unresolved Milky Way starlight
Gaia DR3 (I/355/gaiadr3) and Hipparcos (I/239) via VizieR TAP
